issues.title: Enter location for `movement` outcomes (right-click handler)
issues.body:
One of the potential outcomes of an interaction is a `movement` - it's particularly valuable in `Transit` activities.

**Note:** we have a temporary workaround for this, in #2198 / #2189 

Here is an alternate way of supporting this:
- a right-click on the map silently stores the lat/long in an array on the clipboard.  This can then be pasted into the box

If we can't write to the clipboard (because our app won't be running on an `https` connection - so the browser won't allow clipboard access), then let the user copy it themselves by making the right-click handler popup the coords in an alert:
- https://stackoverflow.com/a/6055620/92441

**Note:** it _looks-like_ this is how we catch events with `React-LEaflet`: https://react-leaflet.js.org/docs/api-map/
